test_name: Awareness and Training - AT-3 Fully Implemented
architecture:
System: Citizen-Services-014
Primary NIST family: Awareness and Training (AT); evidence focus: AT-3.
Environment: AWS GovCloud. Network access uses PrivateLink; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: training completion records are retained and reconciled against the active workforce roster. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
